strings.Str.PropDesc.ForeColor: The colour used for the object's text and graphics.
strings.Str.PropDesc.Icon: The icon shown when the form is minimised.
strings.Str.PropDesc.BackColor: The background colour used for the object's text and graphics.
strings.Str.PropDesc.BorderColor: The colour of the object's border.
strings.Str.PropDesc.FillColor: The colour used to fill shapes such as circles and boxes.
strings.Str.PropDesc.MaxButton: Whether the form's title bar shows a Maximise button.
strings.Str.PropDesc.MinButton: Whether the form's title bar shows a Minimise button.
